description: This file defines the ADODB_Encrypt_MD5 class, which provides methods for encrypting and decrypting data using MD5-based cryptography within the ADOdb session management system. It includes dependencies on a cryptographic class and performs session security functions.

classes.name: ADODB_Encrypt_MD5
classes.description: A class providing MD5-based encryption and decryption methods for session data management.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Encrypts the given data with a provided key using MD5 cryptography.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Decrypts the given data with a provided key using MD5 cryptography.
